ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota
questions: How are Medicaid payments being diverted?
What are the consequences of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: I think this story is important because it gets to the heart of how Medicaid fraud is happening in Minnesota. By following the money, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals
